title: Good visit with an excellent guide.
text: Due to issues with tickets to the Alhambra, it was a night tour of the Nasrid Palaces and not of the Alhambra itself. Our guide Eva managed everything. It was a very interesting visit. It is clear that Eva knows a lot about the Alhambra and that she enjoys it. Her knowledge and interest are contagious, and we had a great time. I really appreciate that Eva visited us in English despite the tour being advertised in Spanish, because my partner does not speak Spanish. An experience that was truly worth it!
author: xavierg12685

title: A fascinating visit to the Alhambra!
text:
Eva was our guide at the Alhambra. She dedicated more than 3 hours to explore all the corners, a true pleasure. We had an amazing time. The entire history was super interesting and detailed, also generating intrigue with the legends told. We highlighted her kindness, dedication, and passion conveyed in each story. We felt extremely grateful and enjoyed the entire visit very much.
Highly recommended!
author: Fernan P

title: We were surrounded by water
text: I'm a lifelong pomegranate and I didn't expect to learn as much and discover as many corners as I did with Eva. An experience of 10 to repeat again. The tour we did night because of the heat it is in pomegranate in June and since we were all surrounded by water I did not spend any heat.
author: lauraoI4517KP

title: Wonderful tour
text: Extraordinary tour of the Nasrid buildings, knowing life and customs of its inhabitants by the hand of Eve. Walking around the Albaicín has been a pleasure in your company, which once again we have been lucky to have it all to ourselves!!! Last year we found an excellent guide and we left a friend. I hope to return a third time to Granada and rehire your services. I'll recommend you to all my acquaintances. A hug
author: carloslJ4077KM

title: Fantastic guided tour of the Albaicín
text:
Beautiful tour of the Nasrid history of the Albaicín.
We really enjoyed the tour we took with Eva who took us through Nasrid streets and houses, explaining in detail the history and way of life of its people.
Highly recommended, thank you very much Eva for everything.
We will meet again in Granada....
author: Paqui-Burela

title: Wonderful.
text:
It was a wonderful experience. The buildings we have visited are extraordinary, both for their beauty and their history. Walking around the Albaicin to get from one to the other has been a real pleasure. But of course, the most important part of this visit is the guide: Eva is unique, both for her person, she is a real charm, and for the amount of knowledge she has of history of every street, every house, every corner, and the simple way to get it to you. With it you get transported in time..... Thank you very much Eva for such an extraordinary morning. 
I recommend to everyone who is in Grana
author: Bluuangani

title: Magnificent visit
text: A great experience Eva takes us to another time with her explanations. A highly recommended visit. I will repeat with other visits without a doubt.
author: angelesmR4534JV
